points.point: Battle card 的競品比較本質是 sales positioning，不是可引用的技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: says battle cards cannot replace formal specifications and are sales positioning

points.point: 對競品的主張只有 R&S 內部 battle card 單一來源，對外使用前須補競品官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: requires competitor official datasheets/configuration/service terms or third-party evidence for Keysight/Anritsu/amarisoft claims

points.point: battle card 數字不可當作 binding specifications，引用時只能標示為特定日期的 sales claim，並等待正式規格文件
points.label: partial
points.why: warns not to use battle cards as specs, but does not clearly say battle-card numbers are only dated sales claims pending formal specs

points.point: AI 相關的 R&S 自動化工具（AI Script Assistant / CONTEST）在 battle card 中未提供文件版次，Keysight toolchain 需官方資料
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions AI claims need better evidence and competitor official sources, but omits AI Script Assistant/CONTEST, missing document versions, and Keysight AI toolchain specifics

points.point: CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 的能力只有 PR 說法，缺 benchmark、correctness metric、coverage matrix 與驗證條件
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is only PR-level and lacks benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, and validation conditions

points.point: non-signaling / production 平台的能力主張，必須分別引用各平台的正式 source page
points.label: partial
points.why: requires formal sources for non-signaling/production claims, but only discusses CMP180 rather than each relevant platform source page

points.point: 競品官方 brochure 可用於描述競品，但不可用來驗證 R&S 自家的優勢主張
points.label: partial
points.why: says competitor official documents should support competitor claims, but not that they cannot validate R&S advantage claims

points.point: AI-assisted 測試工作流的價值需用可量測指標衡量，而 PR 語言未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法
points.label: missing
points.why: does not require measurable AI workflow metrics or quantitative validation methods
